text: 【全球首个AI脑机接口医疗器械标准落地 十五只概念股获机构密集调研】政策红利持续释放、技术应用加速迭代，脑机接口产业商业化进程提速，成为资本市场重点关注的前沿赛道之一。9月14日，国家药监局批准发布我国第三个脑机接口医疗器械标准，这也是全球首个采用人工智能技术处理脑电数据的脑机接口医疗器械产品标准，该标准将于明年9月1日起正式实施。
text_en: [World's first AI brain-computer interface medical device standard issued; 15 concept stocks receive intensive institutional research] With policy incentives continuing to be released and technological applications accelerating, the commercialization of the brain-computer interface industry is speeding up, making it one of the frontier tracks of key focus in the capital market. On September 14, the National Medical Products Administration approved and issued China's third brain-computer interface medical device standard, which is also the world's first product standard for brain-computer interface medical devices that uses artificial intelligence technology to process EEG data. The standard will officially take effect on September 1 next year.
